Hero memory point at a glance: warm dusk cafe glow plus the cup-holding figure silhouette against harbor sunset. Behind the cafe, calm harbor water and distant boats sit in cool blue-violet air perspective under a golden-orange sunset sky. Soft glossy cartoon 3D rendering like casual lifestyle game posters: rounded forms, soft block highlights, warm saturated palette (#F4C84A amber, #E85A4F coral accents, #5BA3D9 dusk sky, creamy skin highlights), no hard black outlines. Commercial store-listing Key Art clarity. Opaque full scene background.
